cs.t: I'm in AB and work at a Windows/MS-based shop, and haven't run into any real problems with any Windows/Apple/Linux systems with the time change. Our IT department ran a couple scripts last week and everything this week has been smooth sailing. Things I have run into problems with have been my smart thermostat (ecobee, now fixed), my Philips Hue lights (most of my automations are via Home Assistant, but I have a handful that rely on colour temp in the Hue app), and my Ford car. (Auto time zone and auto time aren't separately configurable, and auto time zone puts me in the wrong time zone.)
cs.th: Microsoft's Canada timezone troubles leave admins fixing calendars

cs.t: After using a 3rd gen for 8 years, I just replaced my Nest 3rd gens with Ecobee Premiums. Used to be a proud Nest user, they even shaped my choice of a new home HVAC system to be something compatible. However, they (and their software) haven't changed since I bought them, they are stuck in 2015. Meanwhile Ecobee has been producing beautiful hardware and software that has not only caught up but surpassed the 5+ year headstart that Google/Nest squandered. Also read Build and I'm sure Tony is just sad at seeing the opportunity lost as Nest becomes a shell of itself.
cs.th: Google keeps failing its Nest customers
